Header and footer line styles

header_line_style.Rd

Styles for [bb_running_header()] (`header_line_style()`) and [bb_page_footer()] (`footer_line_style()`).

Usage

header_line_style(
  left_style = NULL,
  right_style = NULL,
  rule = line_style("primary", 2),
  space_above = 0,
  rule_gap = 0.1,
  space_below = 0.07
)

footer_line_style(
  left_style = NULL,
  right_style = NULL,
  rule = line_style("rule_strong", 1),
  space_above = 0,
  rule_gap = 0.16,
  space_below = 0.1
)

Arguments

left_style, right_style

Text styles (or role names). Defaults: roles `running` / `running_right` for headers, `footer` for footers.

rule

A [line_style()] or `NULL`.

space_above, rule_gap, space_below

Vertical spacing.

Value

A `bb_header_line_style` object.

Examples

header_line_style(rule = line_style("primary", 2))
#> $left_style
#> NULL
#> 
#> $right_style
#> NULL
#> 
#> $left_role
#> [1] "running"
#> 
#> $right_role
#> [1] "running_right"
#> 
#> $rule
#> $color
#> [1] "primary"
#> 
#> $lwd
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $lty
#> [1] "solid"
#> 
#> $alpha
#> NULL
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "bb_line_style"
#> 
#> $space_above
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $rule_gap
#> [1] 0.1
#> 
#> $space_below
#> [1] 0.07
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "bb_header_line_style"
